lines.text: Monster, lay-to your fingers: help to bear this away where my hogshead of wine is, or I'll turn you out of my kingdom. Go to, carry this.

content.text: A noise of hunters heard. Enter divers Spirits, in shape of dogs and hounds, and hunt them about; Prospero and Ariel setting them on.

lines.text: Hey, Mountain, hey!

lines.text: Fury, Fury! There, Tyrant, there! hark, hark!

content.text: [Caliban, Stephano and Trinculo are driven out.]
